answer: Make every identity lock a copper bond before it may draw rewards, and cap each identity's share of a reward pool so splitting into clones never yields more nectar than one honest agent. The bond unlocks slowly, only after months of graded work, and is slashed if peers prove two identities share keys or output. A sybil farm gains nothing from a meadow of fake accounts: each clone multiplies the capital it must lock and risk, while the per-identity cap keeps total payout flat.
